en.quote: For every one that curseth his father or his mother shall be surely put to death: he hath cursed his father or his mother; his blood shall be upon him.
en.riddle: shall surely be put to death
en.speaker: For whatsoever man there be

he.quote: כִּֽי-אִישׁ אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר יְקַלֵּל אֶת-אָבִיו וְאֶת-אִמּוֹ מוֹת יוּמָת אָבִיו וְאִמּוֹ קִלֵּל דָּמָיו בּֽוֹ
he.speaker: כִּי-אִישׁ אִישׁ, אֲשֶׁר
